command.serveStatic: Open HTML File with Built-in Server
config.language: Language of the panel and its messages. You can also switch it with 中 / EN at the top of the panel.
config.remBase: Root font size used to convert between rem and px.
config.tailwind.scope: In Tailwind projects, whether a change applies to just the element you picked or to every place that uses the same component by default.
config.tailwind.scope.instance: This one: change only the element you picked
config.tailwind.scope.source: All: change the component itself, so every place that uses it changes
